items.title: India's GDP records surprise growth of 7.8% amid Iran war
US defends Trump's Venezuela oil deal
items.description: Trump met oil executives at the White House on Tuesday as he tries to tame gas prices that are spiraling because of the Iran war, with his administration hoping the Venezuela deal could help. Cheaper oil is a priority for the Trump administration ahead of crucial US midterm elections in November.

items.title: As US steps up pressure on Iran, ordinary people say they’re paying the price
items.description: Iran’s economy was in ruins even before the war, and before U.S. President Donald Trump’s latest “D-Day” sanctions. So far, ordinary Iranians are bearing the brunt and feeling apathetic, meaning surviving leaders, for now, might face a lower risk of an uprising.

items.title: Palestinians mourn children killed in Israeli airstrikes on Gaza City
items.description: Three Palestinian children were among four people killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza.

items.title: Putin, Pezeshkian Reaffirm Moscow-Tehran Alliance Amid US-Iran War
items.description: Iranian President Masud Pezeshkian thanked Russian President Vladimir Putin for Moscow’s position on the war in the Middle East, in their first meeting since the conflict broke out in February.

items.title: War and sanctions deepen Iran's fuel crisis
items.description: Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints and new US sanctions squeeze supplies.

items.title: Why the Middle East Oil Shock Failed to Save Russia’s Budget
items.description: Six months into the U.S.-Iran war, Russia’s oil windfall looks surprisingly meager despite initial predictions of a revenue boom.

items.title: Why did Modi urge Putin to end Ukraine war - and will he listen?
items.description: BBC correspondents in Delhi and Moscow look at why the Indian PM made a very public peace plea to his Russian ally.

items.title: Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb
items.description: The confirmed death toll from Nepal’s catastrophic floods has surged to 903, with more than 4,200 still missing as rescue crews and humanitarian workers battle blocked highways to reach the hardest-hit areas, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday.
